provenance.title: Product model · n = 2 · Hotyn-M 2.1 · run 61
provenance.text: 47 product obligations → HM61-1: 84 elements, 68 leaves, 47/47 whole (closed); HM61-2: 91 / 75, F19 residue. Leaves ×1.10, coverage-set Jaccard 0.51. The first launch of both repeats stopped for contamination: the pinned product projection quotes a duration it says it removed; the figure was struck in the prompt and fresh instances launched.

provenance.title: Work model · Hotyn-W 1.2 · run 62
provenance.text: 4 batches, one crossing each → 521 element-attached items, 0 row mismatches (after a read-time fix of one group-definition phrasing). F51 absorbed by the production cutover; F48, F49, F50, F52 standing as own branches.

provenance.title: Size classes · n = 2 · Hotyn-D 2.0 · run 63
provenance.text: 64 / 63 leaves sized, 95.6% class agreement; 4 / 5 unsizeable (L27, L38, L51, L56; + L46). Assembly 10 094 / 9 747 net task hours, ×1.036.

provenance.title: Demanded-work rows · Hotyn-K 1.1 · run 64
provenance.text: W-F49 (62.7 h) and W-F52 (37.3 h) priced; W-F48 and W-F50 refused — headcount and parallel-run period undeclared. Raw chain 9 846–10 194 h.

provenance.title: Outside view · n = 2 · Lytin-R 1.1 · run 65
provenance.text: One class (in-house second-generation rewrite of a distributed back-end with a parallel-run cutover), 55% confidence. RC65-1 in recorded 168-h months, leave out: 80 / 150 / 240 / 310. RC65-2 in staffed months, leave in: 55 / 105 / 175 / 240.

provenance.title: Step C rates · Lytin-K 1.1 · run 66
provenance.text: Gap-blind. Fills A1–A5 (A5 unpriceable), T1–T5, two globals G1 (within-day overhead) and G2 (era + learning curve). Fills priced by the orchestrator's script through rate table v0.1-h.

provenance.title: Steps B, D · Lytin-G 1.1 · run 67
provenance.text: Units first: G1 duplicates the pinned 6-h day, chain stopped at G2. Centre 17 350 h, corridor 11 795–26 330, reserve = raw class tails. Explained 83% against RC65-1; overshoot against RC65-2.

provenance.title: No method ×10, and a Delphi among them · run 69, added beside the estimate
provenance.text: The requirements and the assumption log handed to ten bare agents with no sensor definition (the pinned prompt of run 41, unchanged), launched together on 17 September: ten thin curves, each run’s declared total as the mode and its declared range as five sigma in log space, the rule run 43’s curves were drawn with. The thick ochre curve is their plain average. Then the same ten, each keeping its own context, read all ten replies — anonymous, verbatim, nothing of the moderator’s — and revised or held: the thick teal curve is the average after that exchange. Spread of totals ×1.38 → ×1.08; centre 122.5 → 126.5 pm; against the actual ×1.53 → ×1.56. Not part of the run-61 estimate. The older family of twenty (runs 41 and 43) is on report 15:25 of 16 Sep.

pooled.legend: The ten averaged — the mean of the ten independent curves (mean of totals 125 pm = 2 625 pd)
Consensus — the same ten after reading each other, one Delphi exchange (median 126.5 pm = 2 657 pd)
